name: First Blood
rule: Win a finished rated or casual game without assistance.

name: Honours Even
description: Hold an engine to a draw.
rule: Draw a finished rated or casual game without assistance.

name: Ten Victories
rule: Win 10 rated or casual games without assistance. Each opponent counts once per day.

name: Fifty Victories
rule: Win 50 rated or casual games without assistance. Each opponent counts once per day.

name: Hundred Victories
rule: Win 100 rated or casual games without assistance. Each opponent counts once per day.

name: Five Hundred Victories
rule: Win 500 rated or casual games without assistance. Each opponent counts once per day.

name: Thousand Victories
rule: Win 1,000 rated or casual games without assistance. Each opponent counts once per day.

name: The Final Spell
rule: Win a game by checkmate.

name: Untouched
description: Win without losing a single piece.
rule: Win a game of at least 20 moves in total without losing any piece or pawn.

name: Turned Tide
description: Win from a big material deficit.
rule: Win a game after being at least 3 pawns down in material at any point.

name: Upward Duel
rule: Win a game against an opponent rated above you (both ratings recorded in the game).

name: Giant Slayer
description: Beat an opponent rated 200+ above you.
rule: Win a game against an opponent whose recorded rating is at least 200 above yours.

name: Titan Slayer
description: Beat an opponent rated 500+ above you.
rule: Win a game against an opponent whose recorded rating is at least 500 above yours.

name: Unbound Victory
rule: Win a game against Sovereign Unbound at the rated thinking budget (10 s per move) or more.

name: Beyond Time
description: Defeat Sovereign Unbound at its deepest.
rule: Win a game against Sovereign Unbound at a thinking budget of 30 s per move or more.

name: Unbroken Ten
description: Go 10 rated games without a loss.
rule: Play 10 rated games in a row without a loss (draws keep the run alive).

name: Unbroken Twenty-Five
description: Go 25 rated games without a loss.
rule: Play 25 rated games in a row without a loss (draws keep the run alive).

name: Both Sides of the Board
description: Win rated games with both colours.
rule: Win 10 rated games with White and 10 rated games with Black.

name: Precise Hand
rule: A complete Match Analysis with accuracy of 90 or more over at least 20 graded moves.

name: First Spark
rule: Career Brilliant moves in your own games: 1. Counts the latest complete report per game.

name: Five Sparks
rule: Career Brilliant moves in your own games: 5. Counts the latest complete report per game.

name: Constellation
rule: Career Brilliant moves in your own games: 25. Counts the latest complete report per game.

name: Starfield
rule: Career Brilliant moves in your own games: 100. Counts the latest complete report per game.

name: Spark Above
rule: Play a Brilliant move in a win against a higher-rated opponent.

name: Final Flourish
rule: Play a Brilliant move in a tournament final.

name: Last Ward
rule: Win a game in which a critical defensive only move was graded Best.

name: Beyond Yourself
rule: A validated Played Like estimate at least 300 above your rating whose interval excludes your rating.

name: Steady Hand
rule: 10 consecutive estimated games within 150 of your rating.

name: Student of the Game
rule: Complete a Match Analysis of 10 of your own finished games (re-analysing a game does not count twice).

name: Archivist
description: Build a library of reviewed games.
rule: Complete a Match Analysis of 100 of your own finished games.

name: Deep Reading
rule: Complete a Deep (depth 9) Match Analysis of 10 different games.

name: Marginalia
rule: Bookmark 25 different positions in your games.

name: Second Chance
rule: Win 5 different training retries started from your own mistakes.

name: Named
rule: Reach an established Rapid rating (20+ rated games and RD 100 or less) and collect your first insignia.

name: Rating 500
rule: Your established Rapid rating reaches 500 or more.

name: Rating 1,000
rule: Your established Rapid rating reaches 1,000 or more.

name: Rating 1,500
rule: Your established Rapid rating reaches 1,500 or more.

name: Rating 2,000
rule: Your established Rapid rating reaches 2,000 or more.

name: Rating 2,500
rule: Your established Rapid rating reaches 2,500 or more.

name: Rating 3,000
rule: Your established Rapid rating reaches 3,000 or more.

name: Collector
rule: Collect 10 of the 31 rating-title insignias with an established Rapid rating.

name: Curator
rule: Collect 20 of the 31 rating-title insignias with an established Rapid rating.

name: Complete Heraldry
rule: Collect 31 of the 31 rating-title insignias with an established Rapid rating.

name: Ascent
rule: Be promoted to a higher division at the end of a season.

name: Division Crown
rule: Finish first in your regional division league.

name: Crown Bearer
rule: Play in Division 1, the Crown Division.

name: Crown Champion
rule: Win (or share) the Crown Championship.

name: Crown Defended
rule: Win the Crown Championship in two consecutive seasons.

name: Rise Again
rule: Be promoted at the end of the season right after a relegation.

name: First Norm
rule: Score a Federation title norm in a league season, Swiss event or the Crown Championship.

name: Knighted
rule: Hold the Federation Title Knight or higher (earned through norms; permanent).

name: Paladin
rule: Hold the Federation Title Paladin or higher (earned through norms; permanent).

name: Sovereign
rule: Hold the Federation Title Sovereign or higher (earned through norms; permanent).

name: Old Score
rule: Win a game against one of your featured rivals.

name: Best of Five
rule: Lead a head-to-head record against one Federation competitor by 3 or more wins after at least 5 meetings.

name: Wanderer
rule: Win games against Federation competitors from 8 different regions.

name: Grand Tour
rule: Win games against Federation competitors from 16 different regions.

name: Redemption
description: Break a losing streak against one opponent.
rule: Beat a Federation competitor right after losing your last 3 games against them.

name: Nemesis
rule: Beat the same Federation competitor 10 times (once per day counts).

name: Underdog’s Feud
rule: Beat the same featured rival twice when they were rated at least 200 above you.

name: Open Challenge
rule: Win a Random Federation Quick Match (rated or casual).

name: Fortune Favours
description: Win a Quick Match against a much stronger opponent.
rule: Win a rated Quick Match against an opponent rated at least 200 above you.

name: Lightning Strikes
description: Win a Quick Match against a titan.
rule: Win a rated Quick Match against an opponent rated at least 500 above you.

name: Federation Tour
description: Win Quick Matches across the Federation.
rule: Win Quick Matches against competitors from 8 different regions.

name: First Entry
rule: Enter the Federation Open or the Challenger Open (qualifying or registering both count).

name: Swiss Laurel
rule: Finish in the top three of a completed Federation Open or Challenger Open.

name: Last Four
rule: Play in a semifinal of the Crown Championship or the Club Weekend.

name: Finalist
rule: Play in the final of the Crown Championship or the Club Weekend.

name: Champion of the Day
rule: Win a division league, a Swiss event, the Crown Championship or the Club Weekend.

name: Club Weekend Victor
rule: Win the Club Weekend knockout.

name: Saw It Coming
rule: A settled paper forecast whose most likely outcome was priced at 30% or less when you made it, and happened.

name: Opening Position
rule: Hold shares in a Grand Exchange market until it settles (sandbox markets do not count).

name: Right Call
rule: A settled Grand Exchange position that paid more than it cost.

name: Profitable Season
rule: Positive realized P&L over one season with at least 10 settled positions.

name: Back From the Red
rule: A losing season (5+ settled positions) followed by a profitable next season (5+ settled positions).

name: Many Markets
rule: Profitable settled positions in 5 different market families.

name: Clear Sight
rule: At least 10 resolved paper forecasts with a mean Brier score below the public model.

name: True Sight
description: Beat the market over a long sample.
rule: At least 100 resolved paper forecasts with a mean Brier score below both the public model and the market price.

name: Specialist
rule: Within one market family, at least 30 resolved paper forecasts with a mean Brier score below the market.

name: Patron of the Game
rule: Own a chess club.

name: Grand Hall
description: Raise your club to its highest level.
rule: Upgrade your club to level 3.

name: Comfortable Purse
rule: Your net worth (cash, assets and open positions) reaches $5,000 at any recorded point. Sandbox money never counts.

name: Gilded Vault
rule: Your net worth (cash, assets and open positions) reaches $25,000 at any recorded point. Sandbox money never counts.

name: Treasury of Ages
rule: Your net worth (cash, assets and open positions) reaches $100,000 at any recorded point. Sandbox money never counts.

name: Phoenix
rule: Recover from a net worth below $100 to $1,000 or more.

name: Scholar
rule: Complete a Puzzle Rush or an Assessment in the Crown Academy.

name: Puzzle Adept
rule: Solve 100 different Academy puzzles on the first try without hints.

name: Puzzle Sage
rule: Solve 500 different Academy puzzles on the first try without hints.

name: First Lesson
rule: Complete any chapter of The Sovereign's Grimoire in the Academy (solve its exercises, or read a chapter without exercises to the end).

name: Apprentice Graduate
description: Complete Book I of the Grimoire.
rule: Complete every chapter of Book I — The Apprentice.

name: Tactical Scholar
description: Complete Book II of the Grimoire.
rule: Complete every chapter of Book II — The Duelist.

name: Fork Specialist
rule: Solve every exercise of the Grimoire fork chapter (Book II, Chapter 1) on the first try, without a hint, at least once each.

name: Endgame Apprentice
description: Complete the endgame chapters of Book IV.
rule: Complete the Book IV endgame chapters (king and pawn, rook, knight and queen endings, and draws and fortresses).

name: Calculation Adept
rule: Complete the Book IV candidate-move and forcing-line chapters with at least 80% of their exercises solved first try on your first attempt.

name: Academy Graduate
description: Complete Books I–IV of the Grimoire.
rule: Complete every chapter of Books I, II, III and IV.

name: The Sovereign's Trial
description: Complete Book V of the Grimoire.
rule: Complete every chapter of Book V — The Sovereign.

name: Full Season
rule: Play every one of your own fixtures in a completed season over the board (no forfeits).

name: Decade
rule: Complete 10 Federation seasons.

name: The Long Road
rule: Win 5 rated games in a row straight after losing 5 rated games in a row.

name: Midnight Duel
rule: Win a rated game started between 00:00 and 04:00 local time.

name: Unbeaten Ascent
rule: Be promoted after a league season with no league losses.

name: Archmage of the Federation
rule: Own at least one Epic or rarer collectible in every collection.

name: Apprentice Forecaster
rule: At least 10 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score no more than 0.05 worse than the market price.

name: Odds Scholar
rule: At least 20 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score equal to or better than the market price.

name: Market Diviner
rule: At least 30 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score at least 0.01 better than the market price.

name: Odds Alchemist
rule: At least 30 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score at least 0.01 better than the market price; realized P&L across at least 10 settled markets of more than $0, even after removing your single best market.

name: Hedge Wizard
rule: At least 50 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score at least 0.02 better than the market price; realized P&L across at least 20 settled markets of more than $0, even after removing your single best market; profitable positions in 3 market families.

name: Grand Speculator
rule: At least 75 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score at least 0.02 better than the market price; realized P&L across at least 30 settled markets of $250 or more, even after removing your single best market; profitable positions in 3 market families.

name: Oracle of the Exchange
rule: At least 100 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score at least 0.03 better than the market price; realized P&L across at least 40 settled markets of $500 or more, even after removing your single best market; profitable positions in 3 market families; 3 profitable seasons (5+ settled positions each).

name: Crown Marketmaker
rule: At least 150 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score at least 0.03 better than the market price; realized P&L across at least 60 settled markets of $1,500 or more, even after removing your single best market; profitable positions in 5 market families; 3 profitable seasons (5+ settled positions each).

name: Sovereign of Probability
rule: At least 250 resolved paper forecasts on different markets with a mean Brier score at least 0.05 better than the market price; realized P&L across at least 100 settled markets of $5,000 or more, even after removing your single best market; profitable positions in 5 market families; 5 profitable seasons (5+ settled positions each).

name: Wandless Wanderer
rule: Your established Rapid rating reaches or passes through 0–99. Kept even if your rating falls later; provisional ratings never collect.
